items.question: What does Incode do?
items.answer: Incode is an Italian creative studio that specialises in full-stack development. We build websites, e-commerce platforms and custom digital products, and we provide UX/UI design, evaluation and consulting.

items.question: Where is Incode based?
items.answer: Incode Srl is based in Italy. The registered office is in Asola (Mantua) and the operating office is in Cremona at Co-Box, Via dell'innovazione digitale 3.

items.question: Which technologies does Incode work with?
items.answer: For websites and e-commerce we work with WordPress, WooCommerce, Drupal and Shopify. For custom projects we use Ruby on Rails, Node.js and Vue.js, plus software architecture and system integration.

items.question: How can I contact Incode?
items.answer: You can email info@incode.it or call +39 0372 027375. We work with clients as partners, not just as vendors.

items.question: When was Incode founded?
items.answer: Incode was founded in 2007 and has been building digital products for agencies and brands for nearly two decades.
